name: How long does a typical kitchen renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen renovation depends on its complexity and scale. A minor cosmetic update might be completed in 2-4 weeks, while a mid-range renovation involving new cabinets, countertops, and flooring typically takes 6-10 weeks from demolition to completion. A full gut renovation or a major remodel that involves layout changes, plumbing, or electrical work can extend to 10-16 weeks or longer. Factors like material availability, permit approvals, and unexpected issues can also influence the timeline. Planning and clear communication with your contractor can help manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen renovations generally take 2 to 16 weeks, depending on the project's complexity and scope. Minor updates are quicker, while major remodels take longer.
